headline: Thursday and Friday Pressers
body: Ryan Sessegnon is suspended for Fulham, a ban and not an injury.

quote.text: We have a small problem with Hugo – his groin. We will check today, but I’m not sure if he will be okay for tomorrow. Everyone else is available.

teamNews.line: Erling Haaland returns refreshed from a few days off, and Phil Foden is available again after a long spell out.

quote.text: [Apart from] Antoine Semenyo, the rest, they are all available.

teamNews.line: Amar Dedic is ruled out of Saturday's match, and Ewen Jaouen faces a couple of months out with a hamstring.

quote.text: I think, in the next 30 minutes, he will have an MRI, so we will get more clarity then. We hope that it is not that serious.

teamNews.line: Nicolò Savona and Igor Jesus are back in training, while Nicolás Domínguez has broken down again.

men.name: Nicolò Savona
men.note: back from a knee injury; in team training, load managed

men.name: Igor Jesus
men.note: back from a calf injury; full week's training, no reaction

men.name: Nicolás Domínguez
men.note: up to eight weeks; muscle, re-injured in training

quote.text: Nico Domínguez joined training as well. Unfortunately, he had a setback and a re-injury, so he will be out for up to eight weeks now. It’s really tough but Igor is back and Savona is on the way back.

teamNews.line: Antoni Milambo and Josh Dasilva are back from injury but being built up gradually, and Yehor Yarmoliuk is suspended.

men.name: Antoni Milambo
men.note: back from a knee injury; training consistently, not just yet

men.name: Josh Dasilva
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; a little closer, minutes to be built

quote.text: Antoni, probably not just yet. He’s trained pretty consistently over the last week, 10 days. Did a really tough sesson today.

teamNews.line: Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Anton Stach are foot doubts, and Joe Rodon is back in full team training.

men.name: Dominic Calvert-Lewin
men.note: foot; bruised, question mark over availability

men.name: Anton Stach
men.note: broken little toe; injections for matches only

men.name: Joe Rodon
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; full team training

men.name: Gabriel Gudmundsson
men.note: trained in recent days, no problem

men.name: James Justin
men.note: fine after training with the squad

quote.text: Anton Stach is struggling still a bit with his foot injury. So, let’s see. I hope it will get better in the next 48 hours but it’s a question mark.

teamNews.line: Jack Grealish is back from a muscle injury, and Merlin Röhl is not yet available.

men.name: Jack Grealish
men.note: back from a muscle injury; to be worked with again soon

quote.text: Mykolenko is doing much better, he’s got a chance for the game and Christian [Norgaard] has still got a wee bit to go, but I think I could use him at different times if required.

teamNews.line: Hidemasa Morita faces a few weeks out with a recurring groin problem, Elliot Stroud is out with a knee injury and Matt Crooks is suspended.

men.name: Jack Butland
men.note: back from a shoulder injury; training with the group, decision Friday

men.name: Hidemasa Morita
men.note: a few weeks; groin, same leg again

quote.text: Jack is in training sessions with the group, which is excellent news. Yes, [he could be involved]. We will see, we will decide tomorrow.

teamNews.line: Moises Caicedo is ready after his fitness was managed, while Maxence Lacroix faces a few weeks out.

quote.text: He’s not going to be fit for tomorrow. That’s the bad news about this international break, that he picked an injury on his ankle and he’s going to be out for a few weeks.

teamNews.line: Bobby Thomas is unsure for the weekend with a small calf problem, and an ankle problem is holding up Josh Eccles's rehab.

quote.text: Aurele is working away. It’s a 2-3 month injury, so we’re working through that.

teamNews.line: Cristhian Mosquera and Ben White are available, while Noni Madueke must get through a full session on Saturday.

quote.text: Probably [he will be out until after the international break]. He needed another scan to see the amount of fluid that was there resolving. Afterwards, we will know more about it.

teamNews.line: Cody Gakpo has an ankle injury and Alex Isak a small thigh injury, neither thought long term, while Jeremy Jacquet is fit.

quote.text: Alex Isak and Cody Gakpo will not play the game. They are not ready. Unfortunately for us, both got injuries during the international break.

teamNews.line: Kobbie has returned to training and Luke's issue is short term, but Patrick looks set to miss a number of weeks.

quote.text: Ben is further away, with the issue he has got. He won’t be ready.

teamNews.line: Bentancur is suspended, while Lucas Bergvall, Mudryk and Savio are out.

quote.text: Porro, Tonali, Maddison, all are available to play. Normally, we have to understand the situation in terms of physical condition, but all of them are ready.

teamNews.line: Aaron Wan-Bissaka and Ruggeri are also clearly out, with others in pain after Wednesday's match to be assessed in Friday's session.

quote.text: Marco is out, Onana, Cisse out, Pau, Maatsen out, Goretzka out, Madjo out. I think that’s enough. The other players are ready.

teamNews.line: Pascal Struijk will miss the weekend but is expected back afterwards, and Kaoru Mitoma needs more patience.

quote.text: He’s young, he will recover fast. He definitely will be an option for tomorrow.

teamNews.line: Ballard is sidelined for a few weeks with a medium-term injury, and Nordi Mukiele has a minor, short-term problem ahead of Saturday.

quote.text: [Isidor] should be available. At the minute, except Ballard and Romaine, all our players are more or less available.

teamNews.line: Brooksy is fully in team training, and the plan is for Eli Junior Kroupi to rejoin the squad.

quote.text: Now we’re going to miss him for some weeks. I think it’s a bigger muscle injury.

teamNews.line: Jorgen Strand Larsen rejoins group training, and Quinten Timber is due back with maybe some minutes on Saturday.

quote.text: He’s ready to play, and we managed him yesterday, because he played two times 60 [minutes] in seven days, and normally he has to play only two times 30 [minutes].

teamNews.line: Sasa Lukic is held back from the weekend with a groin injury so that he is fully ready for the Hull City match.

quote.text: No, he’s not going to make it. Sasa will be out tomorrow. It’s taken a little bit longer.
